hypothesis: Per-request work, decoding rounds, long-prompt processing, and initial-execution overhead explain instruction counts using cheap workload-specific entry-state proxies.

pcvs.name: request_count_proxy
pcvs.rationale: The supplied workload sets use_tqdm to batch size minus one, providing a cheap proxy for per-request work.

pcvs.name: decode_rounds_proxy
pcvs.rationale: Matches each batch's maximum requested generation length, approximating engine-step overhead.

pcvs.name: long_prompt_requests
pcvs.rationale: Measures batch size for the long shared-prefix prompt regime.

pcvs.name: initial_batch
pcvs.rationale: Identifies initial execution overhead and the batch without progress reporting.
